## Import



BDRC disaster recovery VPC mapping can be imported using the compound id sitePairId#vpcMappingId, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Bdrc/disasterRecoveryVpcMapping:DisasterRecoveryVpcMapping example sitepair-1sxvs5oj#13
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
